profile_text.body:
Synopsys is a public company headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, traded under the ticker SNPS, with SEC CIK 0000883241. Its website describes it as delivering silicon-to-systems solutions for EDA tools, semiconductor IP, and systems verification, and says these help innovators accelerate development, reduce risk, and drive breakthroughs. The site also carries a headline about Synopsys advancing power and performance for AI and multi-die designs on the latest Samsung Foundry processes at SAFE Forum 2026.

The AI-related material on the site is a chatbot notice. The notice states that visitors are interacting with an AI-powered chatbot that provides general information about Synopsys, including its products and services, and that this information may be incorrect or incomplete. It adds that the terms of applicable agreements supersede anything the chatbot says, that chats may be accessed by Synopsys and its service providers to customize the experience and improve the tool, and that using the chatbot is agreement to that data processing.

The company's litigation record shows 281 cases in California. No specific products or MCP servers are listed for it in the record.
